ovision-invoicing.title: Invoices no longer delayed
ovision-invoicing.summary: Automated invoicing from GHL to Merit Aktiva with business registry data — invoices generated in seconds, not days.

before.text: Ovision had no CRM — their pipeline lived in Trello. Invoices were created manually in Merit Aktiva: the accountant copied client data, verified registry codes, calculated reference numbers, and entered product lines. Each invoice took 10–15 minutes and was regularly delayed.
items: Each invoice done manually — 10–15 minutes
Invoices regularly delayed, especially after Friday production
Business registry data checked manually
Owner's time consumed by paperwork

solution.text: We connected the sales system directly to the accounting software. When an order moves to the 'awaiting invoice' stage, the invoice is created automatically — with official data pulled from the Business Registry, correct dates, and calculated reference numbers.
items: GHL → Merit Aktiva automatic connection
Business registry data pulled automatically
Reference numbers calculated by the system
Invoice generated the moment the order is complete

results.text: Martin can now focus on sales and production instead of paperwork.
items: Invoices generated in seconds, not days
Invoice date is always correct
Business registry data is always up to date
Accountant no longer needs to do anything manually

gemoss-sales-kpis.summary: Business-hours response time calculator and automated daily reporting system for a 6-person sales team.

before.text: Gemoss had no CRM — their pipeline lived in Microsoft Teams. KPIs were calculated manually in Excel once a month. The response time KPI counted weekends and night hours, giving false results that directly affected salaries.

False numbers directly affected salaries

solution.text: We built a response time calculator that only counts business days (Mon–Fri 9:00–17:30, excluding Estonian holidays). Connected ClickUp and Google Sheets with daily automated reporting.
items: Business-hours response time calculator
Daily automated report in Google Sheets
Automatic coffee machine contract counting
Individual results visible per salesperson

results.text: The sales team trusts the system and payroll is based on real data.
items: Real-time overview every morning

Sales team trusts the system

whatIs.title: What is GoHighLevel?
whatIs.p1: GoHighLevel (also known as GHL or HighLevel) is an all-in-one sales and marketing platform designed for agencies and businesses. It combines CRM, email marketing, SMS messaging, funnel building, appointment scheduling, and automation into a single platform — replacing the need for multiple disconnected tools.
whatIs.p2: Originally built for marketing agencies in the US, GoHighLevel has grown into a global platform used by thousands of businesses. However, European companies face unique challenges when implementing GHL: GDPR compliance, local payment integrations, regional workflows, and time zone support. That's where a European GoHighLevel agency becomes essential.

whyLocal.title: Why European Businesses Need a Local GoHighLevel Partner
whyLocal.intro: While GoHighLevel is a powerful platform, implementing it for European businesses requires specialized expertise that US-based agencies often lack.

reasons.title: GDPR Compliance
reasons.description: European data protection laws require specific configurations for consent management, data processing agreements, and the right to be forgotten. We ensure your GHL setup is fully GDPR-compliant from day one.

reasons.title: Local System Integrations
reasons.description: European businesses use local ERPs (Merit Aktiva, e-Arveldaja), payment gateways (Montonio, EveryPay), and e-signature platforms (Dokobit). We build custom integrations that connect GHL to your existing tech stack.

reasons.title: Time Zone & Language Support
reasons.description: Working with a European agency means support during your business hours, communication in your language, and understanding of local business practices and cultural nuances.

reasons.title: Regional Tax & Invoicing
reasons.description: European invoicing requirements differ from US standards. We configure GHL to handle VAT, local tax calculations, and regional invoice formats correctly.

items.question: What is a GoHighLevel agency?
items.answer: A GoHighLevel agency is a certified partner that helps businesses implement, customize, and optimize the GoHighLevel platform. Unlike DIY setup, an agency brings expertise in CRM strategy, automation design, and technical integrations — ensuring you get results, not just a configured tool.

items.question: Is GoHighLevel GDPR compliant?
items.answer: GoHighLevel can be configured to be GDPR compliant, but it requires proper setup. This includes consent management, data processing agreements, right-to-erasure workflows, and EU data hosting. As a European agency, we ensure all implementations meet GDPR requirements.

items.question: How long does GoHighLevel implementation take?
items.answer: A typical GoHighLevel implementation takes 4-8 weeks depending on complexity. This includes discovery, configuration, integration development, data migration, and team training. We follow a structured process to ensure nothing is rushed or overlooked.

items.question: Can GoHighLevel integrate with European payment systems?
items.answer: Yes, but it requires custom integration work. GoHighLevel natively supports Stripe, but European businesses often need Montonio, EveryPay, or local bank integrations. We build these connections using n8n automation.

items.question: How much does GoHighLevel cost?
items.answer: GoHighLevel pricing starts at $97/month for the Starter plan and goes up to $497/month for the SaaS Pro plan. Unlike HubSpot or Salesforce, pricing is flat — not based on contacts or users. Implementation costs vary based on complexity and integration requirements.

items.question: Is GoHighLevel better than HubSpot?
items.answer: It depends on your needs. GoHighLevel is better for agencies and SMBs wanting an all-in-one platform at a flat price. HubSpot is better for enterprise marketing teams with larger budgets. GoHighLevel offers more value for sales-led businesses that need CRM, automation, and funnels in one place.

items.question: Do you provide ongoing GoHighLevel support?
